title: WIST Emission stream line (WIST-5)
description: One line of a stream of Emissions (WIST-5 §3): the header, an Emission, a removal or the trailer. A line is unsigned and never reaches an Aggregator. The schema states member sets and types; the octet form of a stream, the place of each line, the spelling of `count`, repeated member names and the refusals of WIST-5 §3.3 hold beside it.

publisher.description: The Publisher's `domain` (WIST-1 §3.8), compared octet by octet.

collection.description: The name of a Collection of the served Declaration (WIST-1 §5.1).

url.description: An absolute URL, which need not be spelled normalized; the URL of the line is its Normalized URL (WIST-1 §2).

modified.description: A Publisher timestamp (WIST-1 §3.4). The pattern alone does not establish calendar validity.

title.description: At most 256 Unicode scalar values; a longer one is the refusal `cap`, which the schema does not state.

abstract.description: At most 1500 Unicode scalar values; a longer one is the refusal `cap`, which the schema does not state.

html.description: The content as an HTML fragment, from which `extract` and `links` are derived (WIST-5 §4).

text.description: The content as text, which is the `extract` unchanged.

links.description: The links of `text`, in content order.

count.description: The number of lines between header and trailer.
